profile.headline: eLearning Specialist | Instructional Designer | Learning & Development | Curriculum Development | Adult Learning | Gamification | Multi-media Specialist | Graphic Design | Animation | Art | Design | Game Design
profile.summary:
I am a multi-talented artist who is successful at wearing a variety of hats to get the job done. I have held various job titles including the following:
·	Instructional Designer
·	Instructional Developer
·	Training Developer
·	Technical Director
·	Graphic Artist
·	Web Developer
·	Video Game UI Developer
·	UI Developer
·	Animator
 ·	Team Lead
·	Project Manager

Specialties: Specializes in multi-media design and development and animation.

Software used includes, but not limited to:
·	Photoshop
·	Illustrator
·	Image Ready
·	Maya
·	Swift 3d
·	Audition
·	Audacity
·	Premier
·	After Effects
·	Flash

Experienced in web-based languages such as:
·	ActionScript
·	JavaScript
·	HTML
·	CSS
·	Java
·	SQL (MS SQL Server)
·	MS Access
·	PHP

positions.title: Graphic Designer/Front-end Web Developer
positions.description:
●	Designed, maintained, and modified existing client responsive websites 
●	Developed responsive web apps using HTML5, SCSS, SASS, XML, JavaScript, JQuery, JSON in an Angular environment 
●	Conduct analysis using Google Analytics and A/B Testing using Adobe Target 
●	Designed GUI Prototypes and creation of architecture using Figma, Sketch, Muse

positions.title: Instructional Designer
positions.description:
●	Designed and developed over 60 unique training assets, serving thousands of colleagues across five business units and received a combined exceptional satisfaction score
●	Applied Kirkpatrick framework, ADDIE, and adult learning principles in all aspects of design work to create engaging learning activities and compelling course content, material/media (audio, video, simulations role play, and games)
●	Consulted with SMEs to precisely identify target audience, training needs, stakeholder objectives
●	Conducted and lead project meetings, manage project timelines and provided proactive progress reports for management and key stakeholders
●	Uploaded assets to LMS for learner access; Managed assets in virtual project folders for future use
●	Built unique exercises and activities that enhance the learning process and experience
●	Analyzed and applied current trends and best practices in learning technologies and instructional design 
●	Devised tests and quizzes to measure the effectiveness and application of the training 
●	Maintained project documentation and course content in alignment with approved design processes and procedures

positions.title: Elearning Specialist
positions.description:
Design and develop engaging eLearning by incorporating purposeful interactions, animations, and videos
Develop compelling course content to enhance the teams knowledge and skill on current products and services
Design and develop media assets using tools and technologies such as Photoshop, Illustrator, Adobe Animate, Adobe Premier, Audition, JavaScript, HTML, CSS

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
•	Developed New Hire mobile app for various AMEX world markets using Muse, HTML, CSS, and JQuery
•	Collaborated with ID’s and SME’s to design and develop innovative and gamified e-learning simulations using OOP ActionScript, Flash, and Adobe Captivate with Advanced Actions in an Agile and Waterfall environment
•	Graphic design, video and audio editing, and Spanish language translation, as needed

positions.title: Training Developer
positions.description:
OOP using ActionScript to create entertaining and engaging e-learning modules

Graphic design using Photoshop, 3ds Max and Flash

positions.title: Volunteer
positions.description:
I volunteer my time for a variety of services such as:
•	Eradicate invasive plants - identify and remove invasive plants and weeds
•	River clean up - either hike or kayak down the river and remove trash
•	Public awareness - Inform people of our organization and efforts for projects including, but not limited to, natural trails addendum, river clean up, invasive plant eradication, recycling, methods for power conservation and waste reduction.

positions.title: 3d Modeler/Graphic Artist
positions.description: Model 3d objects using 3d Studio Max for military and other e-learning applications.

positions.title: Instructional Designer
positions.description:
·	Record and edit audio assets to be used in the F.A.A.’s FMC-1 course modules using Adobe Soundbooth
·	Create and edit graphical assets used in course modules 
·	Create and edit animations and timing of course modules using Articulate Suite and PowerPoint
·	Perform quality assurance tasks, created/designed forms using Excel to log and track known issues and edits within each course module
·	Edited course to be 508 compliant
·	Designed a file management system to be used during course development

positions.title: UI Designer/Developer
positions.description:
Design and develop functionality for sport based video games.

•	Writing new and editing existing object oriented scripts in a C style environment
•	Work within a team environment to create the NCAA 2010 video game for the PS2 and PSP
•	Collaboration with Engineering, QA, Design and Central Graphics pods to create a user friendly unique UI for NCAA 2010
•	Maintain and create graphical assets such as fonts and images to be used within NCAA 2010
•	Learn and use proprietary pipeline to condition assets to be ready for use in the NCAA 2010 game
•	Design NCAA Gen2 and Gen3 development team T-Shirts
•	Mock and Design UI for Gen2 NCAA 2011

positions.title: Instructional Design and Multi-Media Specialist - Contract
positions.description:
·	Work closely with Subject Matter Exports to design and develop technical training e-learning courses
·	Create graphics and multi-media assets to be used in the course using tools such as Maya, Swift3d, Flash, Photoshop, Adobe Audition and Audacity
·	As acting Instructional Designer I wrote the storyboards and designed the flow of the courses
·	Acted as voice over talent and recorded my voice to be used as the voice over using Adobe Audition and edited audio used within the lessons
·	Designed and developed graphics and other media used in the courses using software including but not limited to Photoshop, Maya, Swift 3d, Illustrator and Flash.
·	Created the animations and developed the ActionScript code that brought life and functionality to the courses.
·	Upload and manage courses in the Learning Management System
·	Designed and Developed electronic course catalog using HTML and JavaScript
·	Clean up and update old courses

positions.title: Animator/Texture Artist/Volunteer
positions.description:
·	U/V map modeled geometry to create custom photo real textures
·	Create and digitally paint photo real textures
·	Research weaponry used during WWII
·	Animate characters and first person perspective weapons
·	Package and export files in preparation to be implemented into the game

positions.title: Web Developer - Contract
positions.description:
·	Meet with clients to assess their needs
·	Work closely with art director and copywriter to design and develop client web sights
·	Directed small team to aid in the development of client sites to meet deadline goals
·	Designed client sites using design and development tools such as Photoshop, Flash, Illustrator
·	Designed direct mail adverts using Illustrator

positions.title: ActionScript Developer - Contract
positions.description:
·	Lead and managed my team in the development of interactive Flash simulations
·	OOP ActionScript development for guided and unguided simulations of Naval equipment
·	Coordinate device development with Instructional Designers and Subject Matter Experts
·	Assisted members of other teams with code and tool development
·	Developed a unique project status and component relationship tool for use within JHT management

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Database modifications in order to update InstallShield Reseller Extranet  Password Protected
•	Worked closely with product managers to launch new products on Web site
•	Maintained updated product information in MS SQL Server database
•	Worked with other team members for necessary updates to Web site and intranet
•	Participated in building InstallShield's support site, which was named one of the "Ten Best Web Support Sites" by the Association of Support Professionals (ASP) 
•	Worked within a team to redesign, restructure and build new InstallShield.com Web site
•	Concept creation and design of product specific banner ads
Design and creation of web site animated product ads
